relationships.subject: KIF5b
relationships.evidence_quote: KIF5b, a highly expressed member of the kinesin-1 family in DRGs, promoted the translocation of Nav1.7 to the plasma membrane in DRG neurons of the rat

relationships.subject: KIF5b
relationships.evidence_quote: Immunoprecipitation experiments further confirmed the interactions between KIF5b and Nav1.7.

relationships.subject: Spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: synchronously increased KIF5b and Nav1.7 expressions were observed in DRGs

relationships.subject: KIF5b
relationships.evidence_quote: intrathecal injections of KIF5b shRNA moderated the SNI-induced both mechanical and thermal hyperalgesia

key_findings: KIF5b promotes Nav1.7 membrane translocation in rat DRG neurons and interacts with Nav1.7.
KIF5b and Nav1.7 are co-upregulated after SNI; KIF5b shRNA reduces SNI hyperalgesia and anxiety-like behaviours.
